summary: Micromem Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K, a report of foreign private issuer, announcing the closing of a non-brokered private placement. The company raised gross proceeds of approximately C$235,000 by issuing 9,400,000 units at C$0.025 per unit, each consisting of one common share and one warrant exercisable at C$0.05 per share for two years. No insiders participated, and all securities are subject to a four-month hold period. Proceeds will be used for working capital. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
